messages:
kai: Quick flag from today's compliance scan — found a set of DB snapshot objects in gs://customer-archive/legacy-uploads/ (2018-2020) lacking our x-encrypt-meta header and no kmsKeyName present.

sarah: Can you paste one example path and the gsutil metadata snippet?

kai: Example key: legacy-uploads/db-prod-2018-07-12.sql.gz. `gsutil ls -L` shows Content-Type and CRC32C only, no encryption headers.

denzel: Older uploads are expected pre-CMEK but we should confirm whether they were SSE-default or uploaded plaintext. Any uploader principal info?

kai: Insert logs point to `backup-agent-legacy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` between 2018-07 and 2020-03. No SSE-C headers found either.

encops-bot: ALERT: missing_encryption_meta detected (count=11) in bucket customer-archive/legacy-uploads. Recommended actions: audit-insert-events, access-log-scan, test-rewrite.

sarah: Immediate triage: 1) run Cloud Logging query for storage.objects.insert for that SA and timeframe; 2) scan access logs for any GETs to these keys; 3) block legacy SA write perms.

denzel: Cloud Logging query provided to ops: `resource.type="gcs_bucket" resource.labels.bucket_name="customer-archive" protoPayload.methodName="storage.objects.insert" protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:backup-agent-legacy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com timestamp>="2018-01-01T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp<"2020-04-01T00:00:00Z"`.

kai: Ran access log grep — no public GETs for the affected keys. Only reads from internal SAs and a partner uploader `partner-uploader@vendor.example.com`.

sarah: Remediation plan: a) revoke legacy SA write binding via infra PR, b) test `gsutil rewrite -k` on a small set to add kmsKeyName and verify restore end-to-end, c) create an escrow manifest mapping original object -> upload event ID for audit.

denzel: Note rewrite costs and KMS grant logs. Use Storage API rewrite jobs with rate limiting. Record all kms operations for compliance.

encops-bot: REMINDER: ephemeral KMS grants for cross-account access must include TTL and automated revoke; record grant IDs in the escrow manifest.

sarah: Legal — tagging you in case we need to notify customers. If no external reads, we'll treat as internal compliance gap, but need a prepared disclosure template.

legal: Acknowledge. Prepare a brief statement template limiting technical detail and providing remediation timeline. We'll only send after security confirms any customer-impacting restores.

kai: Test rewrite on 2 files complete, metadata now includes `kmsKeyName` and our restore tooling successfully decrypted and loaded into a staging DB. No errors.

denzel: I'll open ENCRYPT-OPS-821, assign to kai, set P2, include sample keys, cloud logging queries, and rewrite command. Also add nightly scanner to flag objects missing x-encrypt-meta going forward.

sarah: Good. Also add a pre-merge IaC check so any new storage.objectAdmin binding must include `encryption_review=true` tag.

encops-bot: ACTION: create ENCRYPT-OPS ticket, store escrow manifest in restricted CMEK-protected bucket, record audit pointers.

kai: Will post a short summary to #eng-security tomorrow with ticket link and current status. No external exposure detected so far.

sarah: Thanks — keep this on the radar. If anything changes escalate to #incidents immediately. :warning:
